response.evidence: Add the following content to `src/pages/index.astro` in order to fetch and display a list of all post titles, each linking to its own page
response.rationale: The artifact's 'Displaying a list of blog posts' section explicitly states that the content added to src/pages/index.astro fetches and displays a list of all post titles, each linking to its own page. The accompanying code fetches from Builder's content API with fields 'data.slug' and 'data.title' and renders each title as a link to /posts/${slug}. The other options describe different pages: rendering a single post's HTML and getStaticPaths belong to src/pages/posts/[slug].astro, and Builder's visual editor is shown via src/pages/builder-preview.astro.
